newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Lung Kee Metal IPO 28 times subscribed.
newsitem.headline: Lung Kee Metal IPO 28 times subscribed.

text.p: Lung Kee Metal Holdings Ltd (LKMH), a unit of Lung Kee (Bermuda) Holdings Ltd, said on Tuesday that the public portion of its initial public offering (IPO) was approximately 28 times subscribed.
LKMH had offered 50 million shares at US$0.55 each in its Singapore IPO.
LKMH, which makes mould bases and trades in metals, industry oil and machinery, offered 35 million new shares and 15 million vendor shares.

It placed out 40 million shares and the rest were offered to the public. The offer represented 25 percent of the company's enlarged share capital. LKMH aims to raise US$18.1 million, the bulk of which will finance the construction of new plants in China and Malaysia.
